description.value: Located at Fair Harbour on northern Vancouver Island, this combined campground office and general store serves as a supply point at the remote gateway to Kyuquot Sound. For touring cyclists venturing into this isolated stretch of Vancouver Island, it represents one of the very few commercial stops in the area. Its dual role as campground office and store suggests it caters to travellers needing basic supplies in a region with limited services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned only a security-warning interstitial page with no actual business content, so all amenity fields must rely solely on OSM tags. OSM provides only three tags: name, shop=general, and the website URL. The name 'Campground Office & General Store' and shop=general tag are the only evidence available; no contact details, address, or amenity information can be confirmed.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible general store and campground office in a very remote part of Vancouver Island; OSM marks it as open and it is a plausible and useful supply stop for touring cyclists heading to or from Kyuquot Sound.
